text_block_list.text:
On this day, while I was working
in the Trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
It's Christmas!

Just as Kawakami Princess said, today was Christmas.
Since it was a special occasion, I gave her a day off from training.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it is Christmas, isn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Is it not Christmas
for you as well, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
......Huh.
I'm the only one getting the day off......?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: W-Wha-wha-what in the world is this~?!

And so, Kawakami Princess stormed
out of the Trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum-hum~♪
Hum-hum-hum~♪

Humming a tune while
decked out the Trainer's room in Christmas decorations.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, even if you feel a little peckish,
you must not touch that pizza over there, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Christmas only starts after
we finish work, okay!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, make sure to work up a big appetite!
Because we'll have roast chicken ready too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I might... not have enough...
money... ngh."

...I handed the Christmas funds
to a teary-eyed Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Hm-hm-hm~,
hm-hm-hm~...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ......*silence*
choice_data_list: What are you up to this time?
What are you up to this time?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not doing anything.
I merely thought you might find it easier to concentrate that way.
(Grrr~...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: You can go ahead and eat without me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I want to be together.

"I finish writing the final report.
All that's left is to email it, and work will be—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Is it over!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Then let's dig into our meal right away!
There's still plenty of Christmas time left!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, not to worry!
Once we pop it in the microwave, it'll be piping hot in no time!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's get Christmas started♪

And so, I spent Christmas
with Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Let's head outside first!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! Just microwave it and it'll be
warm and delicious! More importantly, hurry, hurry!

And Kawakami Princess grabbed my hand,
pulling me outside—
(Gwah!)
In the next moment, the sky spread out before my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a princess carry would be
much faster! Please hold on tight!
Kawakami Princess picked up speed at a rapid pace, the wind whipping sharply against my face.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all♪
Compared to my usual barbells,
this is an absolute breeze!"

And where Kawakami Princess led me
was atop a high hill.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer!
Isn't that night view gorgeous?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"When I found this place the other day,
I decided right then that my Christmas
was definitely going to start here!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Hehe♪ I think so too.
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for your hard work.
I'm always grateful for everything you do."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, you're very welcome.

And on the way back to the Trainer's office,
I buy a PreFighter-themed cake.

Though it had gotten off to a late start,
we still ended up enjoying Christmas together
with Kawakami Princess.
